apps.name: Dwindle
apps.summary: A daily word puzzle on a honeycomb grid that disappears as you solve it.
apps.description: Trace hidden words through a hexagonal board. Letters drift away when they are no longer needed, until the board is empty. Daily puzzles are available in English, German, Spanish and Italian.

screenshots.caption: A daily board in the light theme.

screenshots.alt: Dwindle word puzzle in its dark theme
screenshots.caption: The same puzzle in the dark theme.

apps.name: Meltorama 2000
apps.summary: A photo-warping app for macOS and Android.
apps.description: Warp photos in an app inspired by the original Meltorama.

apps.name: Mirio
apps.summary: A browser platformer with a round world, a trip to the moon, and a kart race.
apps.description: Explore a small world with its own gravity, take a rocket to the moon, fight Finster-Mirio, and finish with a kart race. The characters and scenery come from Miro's drawings.

apps.name: QRat
apps.summary: Design QR codes in your browser.

apps.name: WordWarp
apps.summary: Create warped, metallic, and dimensional text in a browser or native editor.
apps.description: A text-art studio with alpha-correct image export. The browser studio and native editors share the drawing engine.

screenshots.alt: WordWarp text-art editor with a dimensional text composition
